name: 土壤有机质含量（烧失法）估算

map.输入灼烧前后的干土重量，估算土壤有机质与有机碳含量（LOI 烧失法）: Enter dry-soil weights before and after ignition to estimate soil organic matter and organic carbon (LOI method)
map.📖 查看「土壤有机质含量（烧失法）估算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Soil Organic Matter (Loss-on-Ignition) Estimator Guide"
map.烧失量 LOI = (烧前总重 − 烧后总重) ÷ 烧前干土净重 × 100%；: LOI = (pre-weight - post-weight) / pre-dry-soil net x 100%; pre-dry-soil net = pre-weight - crucible tare; organic carbon = LOI x 0.58
map.与烧失法同源：先扣除坩埚空重得烧前干土净重，再以「(烧前总重 − 烧后总重) ÷: Same source as LOI: first subtract crucible tare for pre-dry-soil net, then "(pre-weight - post-weight) / dry-soil net x 100%" gives LOI, an approximation of organic matter; organic carbon is organic matter x 0.58. Grade by organic matter (very low <1%, low <2%, medium <3%, fairly high <5%, high >=5%) to assess arable fertility.
map.💡 公式：烧失量 = 烧前总重 − 烧后总重；有机质(%) = 烧失量 ÷ 烧前: 💡 Formula: loss on ignition = pre-weight - post-weight; organic matter (%) = LOI / pre-dry-soil net x 100; organic carbon (%) = organic matter % x 0.58 (Van Bemmelen factor)
map.烧失法（LOI）在 375–550℃ 灼烧，烧失量包含有机质和结合水，结果略高于: LOI ignites at 375-550C; loss includes organic matter and bound water, so the result is slightly higher than true organic matter
map.若称量为净重（不含坩埚），请将\"坩埚空重\"填 0 即可: If the weighing is net (without crucible), just enter 0 for "crucible tare"
map.Van Bemmelen 因子 0.58 假定有机质含碳 58%，适用于一般矿质: The Van Bemmelen factor 0.58 assumes organic matter is 58% carbon and fits general mineral soils
map.📚 深度解析：土壤有机质含量（烧失法）估算: 📚 Deep Dive: Soil Organic Matter (Loss-on-Ignition) Estimator
map.有机质 ≈ 烧失量 / 土样干重（经验换算，非直接等于）。: Organic matter = loss on ignition / dry soil weight (empirical, not directly equal).
map.重铬酸钾氧化法是更准的化学测定。: The potassium dichromate oxidation method is a more accurate chemical measurement.
map.用于耕地质量监测与培肥效果评价。: Used for arable-quality monitoring and fertility-building effect evaluation.
map.风干土 5.000 g 灼烧后剩 4.320 g，烧失 0.680 g。粗略有机: Air-dried soil 5.000 g leaves 4.320 g after ignition, loss 0.680 g. Rough organic matter = organic part of loss; by experience organic matter = 0.68/5 x factor = 13.6% (high; needs potassium dichromate correction since ignition includes bound-water error).
map.只能估算，因为灼烧同时失去结合水与碳酸盐，高估有机质。科研与测土配方以重铬酸钾氧: Only an estimate, because ignition also loses bound water and carbonates, overstating organic matter. Research and soil testing use potassium dichromate oxidation with external heating; LOI suits quick rough judgment.
map.有机质多少算好地？: How much organic matter is good soil?
map.耕地有机质 2% 以下偏瘦、2%~4% 良好、高于 4% 很肥沃（依土类）。提升: Arable organic matter under 2% is lean, 2%~4% good, above 4% very fertile (by soil type). Raising it relies on straw return, manure, and green manure - a slow variable.
map.土壤有机质含量（烧失法）估算工具，通过灼烧前后干土重量的变化计算烧失量（LOI）: This tool estimates soil organic matter and organic carbon via the loss on ignition (LOI) from dry-soil weight change before and after burning; a common soil-fertility assessment method.
map.支持坩埚空重扣除，自动计算干土净重: Supports crucible-tare deduction and auto dry-soil net weight
map.采用 Van Bemmelen 因子换算有机碳含量: Uses Van Bemmelen factor to convert organic carbon
map.自动判定有机质肥力等级（极低至高）: Auto-grades organic-matter fertility (very low to high)
map.纯前端处理，数据不上传，田间实验室均可使用: Pure front-end processing, no upload; usable in field or lab
map.农田、果园、设施土壤有机质监测: Farmland, orchard, and facility soil organic-matter monitoring
